heading: Tasks
intro: Every trader has work that can't be bought off a shelf: nine tasks each, in three stages, done out on the street. Find something, look in on somewhere, carry something across, settle a score. What they're really about is for you to find out.

briefing.title: Dead Air
text: Someone's been broadcasting on an old emergency frequency. Same message, every evening. I've got a feeling it's coming from one of the houses near the railway.
Find yourself a wind-up radio, tune it in and have a listen. I want to know who's still talking out there.

objectives.text: Find the wind-up radio in one of the houses on Duncombe Street.

shot.alt: A terraced street in the game, rifle in hand, with LISTENING in the middle of the screen and a line of the broadcast as a subtitle.

locked: Stages two and three stay locked until a trader trusts you.
